newsitem.title: GERMANY: Germans slightly more upbeat on economy - poll.
newsitem.headline: Germans slightly more upbeat on economy - poll.

text.p: Germans said they felt their beleaguered economy had improved slightly in April compared to last month, a German pollster said on Friday.
The Politbarometer poll by the Electoral Research Group for ZDF television reported that in April 41 percent of Germans thought the economy was going downhill compared to 55 percent in March.
The Federation of German Industry said on Thursday dynamic exports and gradually rising capital investment gave some grounds for optimism but on the whole the economy was sluggish.
Chancellor Helmut Kohl is facing record unemployment and government plans for a sweeping tax and pension reform he says are needed to help regenerate the economy have been deadlocked.

The survey showed Germans regarded the opposition Social Democrats (SPD) as equally able to tackle the country's economic problems now as Kohl's Christian Democrats and Bavarian sister party, the Christian Social Union (CDU/CSU).

Twenty-one percent of Germans said the CDU/CSU were most able to solve Germany's economic problems, but the same number said the SPD were most able to solve the problems while 30 percent said neither major party could do this.
Kohl remained more popular than SPD leader Oskar Lafontaine with 45 percent supporting him compared to 39 percent for the SPD politician.

But pitted against SPD premier of Lower Saxony premier, Gerhard Schroeder who is widely seen a potential chancellor candidate in the general election next year, Kohl only gained 34 percent support compared to Schroeder's 55 percent.

In a general election 39 percent said as they did last month they would vote CDU/CSU and five percent would support junior coalition partner the Free Democrats. Thirty-six percent said they would vote SPD, up one point from last month.
The survey was based on telephone interviews with 1,264 Germans. It has a margin of error of 2.5 percent for larger parties and around 1.5 for smaller ones.
